question: Where can I find fast food restaurant that falls within 50 kilometers in the direction of travel toward Go Ape Treetop Adventure Course, Strongsville, OH?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.629472 41.530044)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.818381 41.322133)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.629472 41.530044)',4326)::geography, 50000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.629472 41.530044)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
